title: The Lame Horse
text: A fine warhorse, saddled and bridled in good leather, stands in the road on three legs, its eyes rolling white. Its rider is nowhere to be seen. There is blood on the saddle, and the stirrups are still swinging.

options.label: The best healer sees to its leg and wins its trust.

outcomes.text: It walks again and follows you down the road, kicking the first thing that comes at you.

options.label: Take the saddle and gear. Its rider will not be back for it.

outcomes.text: The tack is fine. In the saddlebag is a purse, sticky with blood.

options.label: End its pain; it is the only mercy left to give.

outcomes.text: It is the kind thing to do, though it does not feel kind.
